text: General merchandise (clothing, home goods, toys) can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund, provided the item is unused and in its original packaging.
Electronics (phones, laptops, headphones, cameras) have a shorter return window of 15 days from delivery due to rapid depreciation. Items must include all original accessories and packaging.
Items marked as final sale or clearance are not eligible for return or refund under any circumstances, except in the case of manufacturing defects.
Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5-7 business days of the returned item being received and inspected at our warehouse.
If an item arrives damaged or defective, the customer is eligible for a full refund or free replacement, and does not need to cover return shipping costs.
All electronics purchased come with a standard 12-month manufacturer warranty covering defects in materials or workmanship, starting from the delivery date.
Warranty coverage does not include accidental damage, liquid damage, unauthorized repairs, or normal wear and tear. These cases are not eligible for free warranty replacement.
Small kitchen appliances (blenders, toasters, kettles) carry a 6-month warranty against manufacturing defects, covering motor failure and electrical faults but not accidental breakage.

Standard shipping typically takes 5-7 business days. If a package has not arrived within 10 business days of the order date, the customer is entitled to a full refund or a free reshipment, their choice.
During officially announced holiday sale periods, the standard return window is automatically extended by an additional 15 days beyond the normal policy for that item category.
Refund requests above $500 in value require manual review by a member of the support team before being approved, regardless of return eligibility.
